title: Scalar/pullback unit compatibility
statement: Let \(A,B\) be commutative rings, \(\varphi:A\to B\) a unital map, and \(f:X\to Y\) a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme]. Use ordinary unbounded small-etale derived module categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], normalized scalar functors \(Q_Y,Q_X\), scalar units \(e_Y,e_X\) [def-pur-exceptional-coefficient-normalizations], geometric derived pullbacks \(L_A,L_B\) with unit comparisons \(l_A:L_A1_A\simeq1_A\), \(l_B:L_B1_B\simeq1_B\), and the normalized comparison \(a:Q_Y;L_B\simeq L_A;Q_X\) [lem-pur-etale-scalar-mate-projection]. Then \(a_{1_A};Q_X(l_A);e_X=L_B(e_Y);l_B\), where semicolon denotes composition in application order. There are no finiteness, properness, flatness, or boundedness assumptions.

proof.text: The composite tensor comparisons for Q_Y followed by B-pullback and for A-pullback followed by Q_X satisfy left unitality by composite_left_unit, using scalar left unitality and the published geometric left-unit laws. Their binary tensor compatibility is etaleScalarPullback_tensor. Apply tensorIso_preserves_unit to the invertible scalar/pullback comparison. Unfold the two composite unit identifications; its conclusion is the desired equation.

theorem etaleScalarPullback_unit
    {A B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (φ : A →+* B)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    (scalarPullbackIso φ f).hom.app (𝟙_ (DerivedCategoryModule A Y)) ≫
      (scalarExtension φ X).map (leftDerivedUpperStarUnitIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).hom ≫
      (ExceptionalCoefficients.unitIso φ X).hom =
    (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) f).leftDerivedFunctor.map
        (ExceptionalCoefficients.unitIso φ Y).hom ≫
      (leftDerivedUpperStarUnitIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) f).hom
